title: Boundary edges of the AND function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i$ be a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates, and let $e$ be a point of the cube whose $i$th coordinate is $1$. The AND function changes value across the edge obtained by flipping coordinate $i$ at $e$ if and only if every coordinate other than $i$ of $e$ is $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$e$ is a cube point with $i$th coordinate equal to $1$
